Finding: Official short interest, borrow pressure, and TTM Squeeze are conflated.
Impact: Can create a convincing but financially invalid score.
Recommended treatment: Separate dimensions and rename outputs accurately.

Finding: No demonstrated out-of-sample evidence that Prime/Subprime predicts short squeezes.
Impact: False confidence and unsafe trading decisions.
Recommended treatment: Reproduce baseline, replay, walk-forward test, compare baselines.

Finding: Random-forest headline sentiment is subjective and not event-aware.
Impact: Dilution or weak promotional news may be mislabeled positive.
Recommended treatment: Replace with source-aware catalyst taxonomy and materiality rules.

Finding: Fast polling is confused with real-time underlying data.
Impact: Stale values may drive live alerts.
Recommended treatment: Track source timestamp, receive timestamp, entitlement, and age.

Finding: Zero borrow fee may mean unavailable, not genuinely zero.
Impact: Prime classifications can survive missing critical evidence.
Recommended treatment: Use UNKNOWN state and confidence penalties/suppression.

Finding: TTM is treated as direct short-squeeze evidence.
Impact: Volatility compression can occur without short pressure.

Finding: N/S/M/L squeeze labels lack documented definitions.
Impact: Backtests may be arbitrary or leak future outcomes.
Recommended treatment: Define objective labels from future path and validate robustness.

Finding: 8% and later RSI/volatility targets lack disclosed validation.
Impact: Exits may be arbitrary and overfit.
Recommended treatment: Recover formulas; benchmark against ATR/state-based exits.

Finding: 10% gain threshold may identify candidates too late.
Impact: System may chase already extended moves.
Recommended treatment: Use state machine and overextension filters.

Finding: IBKR described as free despite possible subscription requirements.
Impact: Implementation may silently receive delayed or missing data.
Recommended treatment: Create entitlement manifest and field-level tests.

Finding: Token rotation and rate limits can interrupt the scanner.
Recommended treatment: Health checks, authorized access method, caching, backoff, fallback.

Finding: Timezone and future-looking timestamps were observed.
Recommended treatment: UTC canonical time and exchange-local presentation.

Finding: Prime/Subprime labels hide missing or conflicting evidence.
Impact: Users cannot judge why a signal exists.
Recommended treatment: Evidence-first table and drilldown with source health.

Finding: Large price gains are assumed to be short squeezes.
Impact: News-driven or manipulated moves contaminate training labels.
Recommended treatment: Separate outcome magnitude from causal classification.

Finding: Different student components use incompatible inputs/outputs.
Impact: High integration cost and fragile coupling.
